pr_title: Support merging update and replacement operations
pr_body:
This PR fixes #5286 by modifying the auto-batcher and how we merge documents when preparing them for the new indexer.

## To do
- [x] Make sure we can auto-batch different operation types.
- [x] Make sure the indexer correctly understands and mixes the different kinds.
- [x] Create a test to see if it mixes the documents correctly.
- [x] Modify the auto-batcher tests for the new behavior.

issue_context.title: Support auto-batching document update (PUT) and replacement (POST)
issue_context.body:
Currently, the engine is not capable of auto-batching tasks of type documentUpdateOrReplace created with a PUT and with a POST. It creates a boundary between those two update kinds. Thanks to the new indexer we can "easily" makes it works and let the engine auto-batch both kind of update together.

I think it will be straightforward in the new indexer, as we are already quite good at mixing deletion with updates/replacements. I already have some pieces of the puzzle correctly assembled in my head:
* A replacement erases all previous changes
* An update erases the top-level fields only but keeps the field from the database, the deletion (so no field), or the last replacement (like tombstones)
* A deletion is like before if it resets documents (like a tombstone).
You can [review the code here](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/df9d10ac4403893693f0ba4d35d31d7d9fe393b2/crates/milli/src/update/new/indexer/document_operation.rs).

You can read more about this [in this Slack thread](https://meilisearch.slack.com/archives/C01A1F4KVGU/p1737973801554859).
comments: As far as I can see, this one doesn't impact the docs. We have no explicit mention of `documentUpdateOrReplace` in the docs, and the new behaviour seems fairly intuitive (i.e. we batch `documentUpdateOrReplace` operations when possible, no matter the targeted endpoint).
